title: wiki init hint is run-on (index.md Or run: kbs wiki init)
description: Papyrus 0.20.1 AT on /workspace/research-pod. show/lint/check/render on a project with no project/wiki/ print a create hint, but the text is run-on: index.md Or run: kbs wiki init. Product rule: put the missing-page line and the init hint on separate lines (or a clear sentence break). Do not change the hint content.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
# Implementation plan: wiki missing-directory hint must not be run-on

This is the prescribed plan. Follow it.

## Intent

As an operator, I want the missing-wiki hint to be readable: the mkdir one-liner and `Or run: kbs wiki init` must not be jammed onto one line after `index.md`.

## Current violation

Python `wiki_directory_missing_message` and Rust `wiki_directory_missing_message` produce:

`wiki directory not found at {prefix}. Create it with: mkdir -p {prefix} && echo '# Wiki' > {prefix}/index.md Or run: kbs wiki init`

Observed: `index.md Or run: kbs wiki init`.

## Product rule

One helper, both languages, **identical** text.

Put the alternative on its **own line**:

```
wiki directory not found at {prefix}. Create it with: mkdir -p {prefix} && echo '# Wiki' > {prefix}/index.md
Or run: kbs wiki init
```

That is a newline after `index.md`, then `Or run: kbs wiki init`. No extra punctuation experiments. No emoji. No second wording for lint vs render.

## Gherkin (first)

Do not rely only on `stderr should contain "kbs wiki init"` (already true for the run-on string).

Update `features/wiki/wiki_research_kb.feature` scenarios that already cover missing wiki (`Missing wiki directory shows create hint`, `Wiki lint reports missing wiki directory`, and **wiki list** if that scenario exists on this branch):

- `stderr should contain "Or run: kbs wiki init"`
- Add a step that the run-on form is gone. If the test harness has no "stderr should not contain", add one small reusable step **or** assert using existing patterns. Preferred observable check: `stderr should not contain "index.md Or run"`.

If `stderr should not contain` does not exist, add it in **both** Python and Rust step modules (parity).

## Implementation

- Change only the two helper functions (and any copied test string).
- CLI list/render/lint automatically pick up the new message.

## Coordination

If `wiki list` missing-dir work landed first, rebase onto that branch or onto `develop` after it merges. Do not revert the list-failure behavior.

## Quality

- Branch `cursor/wiki-init-hint-newline-bf9f` from `develop` (rebase if wiki.rs already changed).
- Push, no PR. No debug. Dual runtime.

## Proof

Show stderr from `kanbus wiki render index.md` on a project without `project/wiki/` with the two-line hint. Comment on this issue.
